identity: Dur Brannoc is safe behind its gates, but outside them the dead come to collect old debts, toll bandits tax the roads and a goblin ore-factor buys every stolen nugget.

quests.title: Debts Beyond the Grave
quests.text: At night Debtbound Zombies walk the {name:pastures} {zone_area:pastures}, knocking on doors to collect debts the clerks wrote off long ago. Put eight of them to rest.

quests.title: Fish for the Pie Crust
quests.text: The bakehouse pies want fish this week, and the rivers and tarns outside the gates are full of Mire Carp. Bring me four; a rod and some patience will do.
quests.lesson: Fishing as an errand at any hour; the catch follows the water's level band.

quests.title: Bread for Tarnwatch Fold
quests.text: Edda Tarnmantle at Tarnwatch Fold on the Frostbarrow Shelf ordered bread and a strong pair of arms. The bread is on the cart; you are the arms.

quests.title: Letter for Merren Oakstamp
quests.text: Our friends need help too, and good bread travels. Take this letter to Merren Oakstamp at Whitebridge Market Close; they will have work for a dwarf who wants to see more of the Accord.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer: one of three other Accord 20-30 zones.

quests.title: Letter for Mariel Waybook
quests.text: Our friends need help too, and good bread travels. Take this letter to Mariel Waybook at Highcourt; they will have work for a dwarf who wants to see more of the Accord.
quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer: one of three other Accord 20-30 zones.

quests.title: Letter for Ilwen Petalmeasure

quests.lesson: Sister-zone offer: one of three other Accord 20-30 zones.

quests.title: Tolls Nobody Granted
quests.text: Toll Bandits stop travellers in the {name:tollwood} {zone_area:tollwood} at night and collect a toll the king never signed. Defeat eight Toll Bandit Archers or Toll Bandits there.
quests.lesson: Night outlaws in the forest belt; archers first.

quests.title: The Ore-Factor's Books
quests.text: The tolls and the stolen ore all end at the {name:goblin_camp} {dir_from_giver:goblin_camp}, where Goblin Ore-Factor Brakk pays in Clasped Purses. Recover two purses from his goblins and close Brakk's account for good.
quests.lesson: Goblin camp and a normal named leader; the line's first debt is settled.

quests.title: Bounty: Ram for the Ovens
quests.text: Repeatable bounty: the ovens are always hungry. Kill six Hill Rams on the {name:heights} by day and I pay for every batch; come back after twenty minutes for the next.

quests.title: Orders for Borin Splitbolt
quests.text: The Accord's line needs dwarves who can settle accounts. Take these orders to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station; the contested lands are your work now.
quests.lesson: Capital to contested zones handoff at 30.
